description: Rotate and delete PDF pages. Turn pages that were scanned sideways and drop the ones you do not need — in one pass over the document. Accepts application/pdf, .pdf; up to 100 MB per file.

outputDir.description: Where to put the results. Defaults to the folder each source file came from. Existing files are never overwritten.

paths.description: Paths to the files to process, absolute or relative to the working directory.

remove.description: Pages to delete: 2, 5-7. Leave empty to keep them all

rotate.description: Turn pages by this many degrees. Adds to the rotation a page already has

rotatePages.description: Which pages to turn. Leave empty to turn every page

name: pdf_pages
